## Problem and result

Describe why this change is needed and the resulting behavior. Link the issue.

## Validation

List lint, tests, contract checks, and archive checks with results.

## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets main from develop (or an external contributor fork).
- [ ] Individual commits preserve the detailed change history.
- [ ] Required scaffold files and rule text remain present.
- [ ] Workflow, contract, and validator changes received careful review.
- [ ] Documentation and wiki are updated where needed.
- [ ] No sensitive information is included.
